Rotary Club of Bombay Uptown

Rotary Fellowship in New York – Building Friendships Beyond Borders

Date: Wednesday, 14 October 2026
Meeting with: Brooklyn Bridge Rotary Club, New York, USA

Rotary Club of Bombay Uptown had the pleasure of meeting fellow Rotarians from the Brooklyn Bridge Rotary Club in New York for a wonderful evening of fellowship, interaction and friendship.

The meeting provided a valuable opportunity to connect with Rotarians across continents, exchange experiences and celebrate the shared values that unite Rotary members worldwide.

The warm interactions and camaraderie reflected the true spirit of Rotary—bringing people together through friendship, goodwill and a common commitment to service.

The meeting marked the beginning of new friendships and the strengthening of international Rotary relationships, creating opportunities for future collaboration and meaningful connections between clubs.

Different cities, different cultures, one Rotary family.

Rotary Club of Bombay Uptown | District 3141
